info.title: BugSnag - Trace API
info.description: Send OpenTelemetry trace data to your BugSnag dashboard.

servers.description: For organizations with projects on app.bugsnag.com
For organizations with projects on app.bugsnag.smartbear.com

200.description: The payload was accepted and will be processed asynchronously. This doesn’t imply that your payload was valid, just that it was enqueued to be processed.

Bugsnag-Sampling-Probability.description: The next sampling probability that should be used with your trace reports

400.description: The payload body was missing, or the `Bugsnag-Span-Sampling` header was empty or not present.

408.description: The payload took too long (>30s) to read from the network.

413.description: The payload was too large (greater than 1MB).

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Api-Key
parameters.description: The API Key associated with the project.  Informs Bugsnag which project has generated this trace report.

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Span-Sampling
parameters.description:
A concatenation of the probability that the spans in this trace report will be sampled (kept), and the number of spans in this trace report. The format is `a:b`, where

  - `a` is the probability between 0 and 1, where 1 means that all in this trace report will be sampled.
  - `b` is the number of spans in this trace report

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Integrity
parameters.description: The SHA1 hash of the payload body, to ensure the payload has not changed enroute.

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Sent-At
parameters.description: 2024-01-01T15:00:00.000Z - The time (in ISO 8601 format) that the trace payload is being sent.

tags.name: Traces
tags.description: The endpoint for sending trace reports to BugSnag

resourceSpans.description: An array of trace reports that will be sent to BugSnag. Should contain at least 1 report.

resource.description: Metadata about where the span was generated from

scopeSpans.description: Describes a unit of work or operation. A trace can be made up of multiple spans

value.description: One of these options must be present
One of these options must be present

startTimeUnixNano.description: The Unix epoch of when this span started

endTimeUnixNano.description: The Unix epoch of when this span ended

timeUnixNano.description: The Unix epoch of when this event occurred

kind.description: The kind of span this is. See [here](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/trace/api/#spankind) for more information

parentSpanId.description: The ID of the parent for this span. If this is the root span, parentSpanId should be `null`.

partial_success.description: ExportTracePartialSuccess optionally used to convey warnings/suggestions to senders even when the request was fully accepted.

rejected_spans.description: The number of spans that were rejected, field holding a `0` value indicates that the request was fully accepted.

error_message.description: A developer-facing human-readable message in English. It should be used either to explain why the server rejected parts of the data during a partial success or to convey warnings/suggestions during a full success

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code]

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English.
